text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser and I are taking a walk when we spot Rice Shower looking distressed.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: What's wrong, Rice? Something happen?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh, um… The vending machine won't give me the drink I paid for.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-it's probably my fault… What if it broke because I tried to buy something?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Say no more. I'll have it fixed up in a jiffy!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It'll be fine! I fixed the TV back home once when the picture cut out!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-but… this is all my fault. You shouldn't have to do anything…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It's really no trouble. Here, let's see if we can't cheer up this grumpy old machine!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: There, there, my sweet vending machine. Did something upset you?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: You must be awfully tired, working so hard with no time off… Say, would you like to nibble on a battery?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Go on, no need to be shy! It's a reward for all your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Okay… now it's time to cough up that drink!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: U-um…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh… I'm pretty sure I just did this a bunch of times until the TV started working again.
choice_data_list: Maybe it was just a coincidence it started working…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: What?! You think?! Well, I guess that's possible…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: That just means I just have to keep trying things until it's fixed. Mun!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You really don't need to do any more. I'm sorry for wasting your time, okay? I'll try and figure something out on my own!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: There's nothing for you to be sorry about! If anything, I'm having a lot of fun!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You're having… fun?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Everything about me's so ordinary that it gets my heart racing when this sorta unusual stuff happens!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: So honestly, thanks for the chance!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-no, I should be thanking you. Not only are you trying to fix the vending machine, you're being so kind…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Tannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hey, it's all good! Now, let's get back to fixing this machine!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Maybe I should try a different approach. Something with some oomph…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Lend us your brains! Give me something with oomph!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Lend us your brains! Give me something with oomph!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: So I should show the vending machine even more love?! Gotcha! Here goes!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Are you really okay like this, my little vendy-wendy machine? If you're not gonna start working now, then when?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, uh… You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ooh, nice assist, Rice! How about it, vending machine? Are you getting the urge to spring into action?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Oh, my… Why are the two of you speaking to that vending machine?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tazuna, who happened to be passing by, plugs in the vending machine's power cord, instantly breathing electrical life back into it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: What?! You mean it wasn't broken?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wait, just give me another chance. I'm going to unleash my secret weapon.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Just stay right there!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser just went racing by me… Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Well, the thing is…

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: There—it should be fine now. Maybe someone tripped over the power cord and accidentally unplugged it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh… So it wasn't broken after all. Someone should tell Tannhauser…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Several minutes later, Matikanetannhauser comes back with a huge bundle of tools.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wait, you already fixed it?!
